name: Owners Behind It
description: Websites for owner-led businesses in Palm Coast, St. Augustine and North Florida. The work starts with a sit-down conversation with the owner.

services.name: Website design
services.description: A custom website built from a discovery conversation with the owner.

services.name: Custom website design
services.description: Not a template. Structure, copy and design shaped around one business.

services.name: Small business website design
services.description: Websites for owner-led businesses that have outgrown what they have.

services.name: Website redesign
services.description: Rebuilding a site that no longer represents the business behind it.

services.name: Google Business Profile setup
services.description: Category, service area, description and photos set up so the business can be found.

services.name: Custom web tools
services.description: A spreadsheet rebuilt as a tool that works on any phone.

pricing.note: Projects begin at $3,000 and are quoted after a conversation. Fifty percent deposit before work begins, balance when the site goes live.

process: A sit-down conversation with the owner. No clock on it, and it is not a sales call.
A written plan: what was found, what would be built, and what it will cost.
The build, with the owner approving before anything goes live.
